name: lexigate-demo
status: implemented by `lexigate mcp` (src/lexigate/mcp_server.py); local quickstart demo database only

tools.name: ask
tools.description: Ask a month-end question in Japanese; fixed queries first, AI-generated SQL only if enabled.

tools.name: list_questions
tools.description: Questions the demo answers with fixed queries: intents, synonyms, examples, as-of modes, metrics.

tools.name: get_semantic_map
tools.description: Model-visible subset of the semantic_map (no permissions, no connection data).

tools.name: resolve_intent
tools.description: Map a question to an intent and parameters without running it.

tools.name: query_metric
tools.description: Run a catalog intent with parameters, or a question.

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.description: SQL and rationale of a previous AI-generated answer (on request), or claim evidence by evidence_id.

tools.name: claim_evidence
tools.description: Lines, approval history and settled payments of one expense claim.
